name: Naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: 7 years of legal domicile and continuous residence in Iceland. Foreign stays are capped at 90 days total per 12-month period; a single stay over 90 consecutive days breaks continuity (extended study absences up to 3 years may be excused with documentation, but the residence period requirement still applies in full).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 7 years of continuous legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Must hold permanent residence in Iceland both at the time of application and at the time of the decision.
4 years of residence for citizens of other Nordic countries (Denmark, Finland, Norway, Sweden).

requirement_groups.name: Cohabiting partner of an Icelandic citizen

requirements.blocker_text: 5 years of residence while cohabiting with an Icelandic citizen who has held citizenship for at least 5 years.
2 years of residence for the child of an Icelandic citizen who has held citizenship for at least 5 years.
5 years of residence counted from the grant of refugee status or a humanitarian residence permit.
5 years of residence for stateless persons.
1 year of residence for a person who previously held Icelandic citizenship.

evidence_required.document: Proof of residence period matching the applicable category

sources.title: Island.is -- Application for Icelandic Citizenship: When Can I Apply: 7-year standard residence, reduced tracks for spouses (4yr, separate file), cohabiting partners (5yr), children of citizens (2yr), Nordic citizens (4yr), refugees/humanitarian (5yr post-grant), stateless (5yr), former citizens (1yr), 90-day-per-year continuity cap

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Iceland). The married-to-an-Icelandic-citizen track (4 years) is modeled as its own file, is_citizenship_by_marriage.json, per this dataset's convention. Language requirement, income thresholds, and criminal-record conditions specific to naturalisation itself (as opposed to the permanent-residence prerequisite already gating this route via isn_current_pr) were NOT explicitly detailed on this specific page -- the source only confirmed 'permanent residence... at the time when an application is submitted and decided on' as a condition; is_permanent_residence.json's language/income/conduct requirements would already have been satisfied to reach that PR status. Flagged as a possible gap if naturalisation itself adds further conditions beyond holding PR.
